name: use-cookie
title: useCookie
description: Options for customizing the behavior of the useCookie hook.

tags.template: - The type of the state to be stored in the cookie.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: - The base name of the cookie.

parameters.name: initialValue
parameters.description: - The initial value of the state.

properties.name: serializer
properties.description: A function to serialize the value before storing it.

properties.name: deserializer
properties.description: A function to deserialize the stored value.

properties.name: initializeWithValue
properties.description: If `true` (default), the hook will initialize reading the cookie.

properties.name: prefix
properties.description:
A prefix to be prepended to the key (e.g., "myApp_").
Useful for namespacing or complying with cookie prefixes like `__Secure-` or `__Host-`.

properties.name: path
properties.description: The path within the site for which the cookie is valid.

properties.name: domain
properties.description: The domain for which the cookie is valid.

properties.name: expires
properties.description: The expiration date of the cookie.

properties.name: maxAge
properties.description: The maximum age of the cookie in seconds.

properties.name: secure
properties.description: If `true`, the cookie is only transmitted over secure protocols (HTTPS).

properties.name: sameSite
properties.description: Controls whether the cookie is sent with cross-site requests.

properties.name: defaultValue
properties.description: The default value to return if the cookie is not found.

returnType.name: [T, Dispatch<SetStateAction<T>>, () => void]
returnType.description: A tuple containing the stored value, a setter, and a remover.
